summary: Afya Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Voting Commitment Agreement dated Sept. 23, 2026, among major YDUQS shareholders (Rose FIP, Zaher Family vehicles, Bertelsmann, Nicolau Esteves, NRE Capital) and Afya as intervening consenting party. The agreement concerns the voting of YDUQS Participações shares, suggesting an impending control-related transaction or governance arrangement affecting the Brazilian education peer. The filing states no price, stake percentage, premium, or closing date. Watch for a subsequent tender offer, merger, or activist-driven board change at YDUQS and any resulting impact on Afya's competitive position.
